name: FastEditor for WooCommerce
author: fasteditor

sections.description:
FastEditor for WooCommerce adds a live product personalization and design studio to your store. Shoppers pick a product, open the editor right on your site, add their logo, text, photos or full design, see an instant true-to-product preview, and add the finished, print-ready artwork straight to the cart, without ever leaving checkout.

It is built for stores that sell customizable and decorated products: promotional products, apparel and textile decoration, print shops, signage, photo gifts and branded merchandise. Instead of emailing artwork back and forth and sending manual proofs, your customers design online and you receive production-ready files automatically.

Why merchants use it

  • Higher conversion on customizable products: customers see exactly what they are buying before they order.
  • No more proofing ping-pong: approved, print-ready files arrive automatically when an order is placed.
  • Fewer production errors: what the customer designs is what goes to print.
  • Works with the store you already have: the editor and the “Design with FastEditor” button sit inside your existing WooCommerce product pages, cart and checkout.

How it works

  1. You mark which products are customizable (with a checkbox or a FastEditor Product SKU).
  2. On those products, shoppers click Design with FastEditor and personalize the item in a live, in-browser editor.
  3. The finished design and its price flow back into the WooCommerce cart, and the print-ready file is delivered to you for fulfilment.

Features

  • Live, in-browser editor for logos, text, images and complete designs
  • Instant, true-to-product preview before purchase
  • Print-ready output delivered automatically via a configurable callback URL, no manual proofing
  • A “Design with FastEditor” button added to any products you choose
  • Customer records synced between WooCommerce and FastEditor
  • Cart sessions and editor pricing synced from FastEditor back into WooCommerce
  • Order and shipping details passed through for fulfilment
  • Optional single sign-on (JWT) so logged-in customers go straight into the editor
  • Per-product control: enable by checkbox or by FastEditor Product SKU
  • Option to disable native WooCommerce product options where the editor replaces them

What you need

  • A WooCommerce store (WooCommerce must be installed and active).
  • An active FastEditor account and API key. FastEditor is a white-label service. Using this plugin requires an agreement and API key from FastEditor. Get started at https://www.fasteditor.com or contact support@fasteditor.com.

For developers

Helper functions:

  • fasteditor_find_product_skus
  • fasteditor_get_product_data_by_sku
  • fasteditor_get_products_in_skugroup

Filters for customizing behavior:

  • fasteditor_override_cart_item
  • fasteditor_extend_smartlink_payload

About FastEditor

FastEditor is an API-first artwork automation platform for the promotional products, print and apparel industry. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the FastEditor application so your customers can design products online and you receive production-ready files. The plugin depends on the FastEditor service to send and receive data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/fasteditor-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → FastEditor and enter your Editor API key and base URLs.
  5. Set the customize-button mode, editor pricing and the print-files callback URL to match your setup.
  6. (Optional) Enable JWT single sign-on. Define FASTEDITOR_JWT_AUTH_SECRET_KEY in wp-config.php as a unique, cryptographically random secret containing at least 32 bytes of entropy (for example, 64 hexadecimal characters generated from 32 random bytes).
  7. Mark a product as customizable using the Design with FastEditor checkbox on the product, or by entering a FastEditor Product SKU.

You will need a FastEditor account and API key to connect the plugin. Contact support@fasteditor.com to get set up.
sections.faq:
Do I need a FastEditor account to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin connects your store to the FastEditor service, which is white-label. You need an agreement and an API key from FastEditor. Contact support@fasteditor.com or visit https://www.fasteditor.com.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin itself is free to download and install. The FastEditor service it connects to is a separate, paid white-label product.

What kinds of products can customers personalize?

Anything you sell that can be decorated or printed: apparel and textiles, promotional products, print and signage, photo gifts, and branded merchandise. You choose exactly which products get the editor.

How are print-ready files delivered to me?

When an order is placed, FastEditor sends the production-ready file to the print-files callback URL you configure in the plugin settings, so files reach your fulfilment workflow automatically.

Does it work with my theme and checkout?

The editor and the “Design with FastEditor” button integrate into your standard WooCommerce product pages, cart and checkout, so it works alongside your existing theme and WooCommerce setup.

Can logged-in customers go straight into the editor?

Yes. With the optional JWT single sign-on enabled, customer accounts are synced and logged-in shoppers open the editor without signing in again.

Where do I get support?

Email support@fasteditor.com.
